desc: No long winded description here, just straight and to the point. DMLS 3D printed from grade 5 titanium, coming in at 8.8 oz and HUB compatible, the Milkman is optimized from the ground up for 9mm rifles/PCC/SMG. It’s the perfect balance of sound and back pressure to keep things quiet and keep your guns running cleaner with no gas to the face. AR9, Uzi, MP5, Scorpion, MCX, AKV, B&T – it doesn’t matter. The milkman was made to rule the 9mm rifle world. Due to the unique flow path it runs much cooler than other 9mm rifle suppressors and because it’s HUB threaded, you can use any HUB-compatible 3 lug, direct thread adapter, or QD mounting system of your choice. It’s full auto-rated, so feel free to get after it with any full auto SMG or FRT. No barrel length restrictions on 9mm. Pistol/handgun/booster use is NOT covered under warranty and it is not recommended. If you’re looking for a suppressor for your Glock look somewhere else but if you’re looking for a suppressor for your rifle/smg/pcc you can just go ahead and stop looking now, you’ve found it.
